aim_summary.goal: Produce a plant-pot system containing four cylindrical features and stabilizing side support geometry.
aim_summary.expected_outcome: The final geometry contains four preserved-form cylindrical features and added side ribs that improve resistance to tipping or lateral instability.

operations_plan.summary: Pattern the existing cylindrical socket boss to obtain four total occurrences and combine the occurrences with the original body.

steps.description: Create four total occurrences of the existing cylindrical socket boss while preserving its geometry.
Combine the cylindrical-feature pattern with the preserved original body.

expected_result.geometry: The resulting model contains exactly four occurrences of the cylindrical socket boss, each retaining the seed feature's form and dimensions.

validation_criteria.description: Verify that exactly four cylindrical-feature occurrences exist in the final model.
Verify that each cylindrical occurrence preserves the form and dimensions of F002 and that unrelated original geometry remains unchanged.

operations_plan.summary: Add side ribs to the four-feature system to improve stability.

steps.description: Create stabilizing rib geometry attached to side regions of the patterned system.

expected_result.geometry: Rib geometry exists on the sides of the four-cylindrical-feature system and connects to the supported body regions.
expected_result.function: The added side ribs provide additional stability to the system.
expected_result.behavior: The side ribs increase resistance to tipping or lateral instability.

validation_criteria.description: Verify that fused rib geometry exists on the sides of the plant-pot system.
Verify that the side ribs broaden or reinforce support of the four-feature system.
Verify that the supported system has improved qualitative resistance to tipping or lateral instability.
Verify that non-targeted geometry and the form and dimensions of the cylindrical features remain unchanged except for local rib attachment.
